'''Sularus Brenn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Flight officer/Legends|flight officer]]. He was a top scoring [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] ace with 42 confirmed kills. Despite injuries requiring cybernetic replacement organs, Brenn continued to fly missions deep into the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] space. The Empire recognized his contributions by awarding him a specially designed [[Medal of Conspicuous Gallantry]] decorated with [[Star/Legends|star]] clusters.
